page_title: BOU 1-0 WOL | Bournemouth v Wolves 23/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' The resulting set piece from Wolves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+4' Andre (Wolves) makes a strong challenge and Thomas Bramall blows for a foul.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Substitution. James Hill (Bournemouth) in, Tyler Adams out.
88' Here is a change. Evanilson is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Eli Junior Kroupi (Bournemouth).
87' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
86' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball. Bournemouth have a corner.
85' Joao Gomes (Wolves) receives a yellow card.
84' Matt Doherty (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Thomas Bramall had an easy-decision to make.
81' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
78' Vitor Pereira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) replacing Jorgen Strand Larsen.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Marcus Tavernier walks off the pitch to be replaced by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
75' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) jumps into a tackle and Thomas Bramall signals a foul.
74' The resulting corner from Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
73' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Bournemouth get a corner.
70' Bournemouth take a short corner kick.

69' Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Jose Sa is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
69' The Bournemouth players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
66' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) replaces Alex Scott.
66' Substitution. David Brooks will be replaced by Amine Adli (Bournemouth).
64' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
63' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
58' Thomas Bramall shows a yellow card to Tyler Adams (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.

56' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
56' Substitution. Santiago Bueno (Wolves) has come on for Jhon Arias.

52' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Jose Sa has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
49' Toti (Wolves) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
48' Bournemouth are ruled offside.
46' Half-time substitution. David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) will not participate anymore and Hugo Bueno is coming on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Vitor Pereira gives a chance to Andre and Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' Thomas Bramall has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' The resulting corner from David Brooks (Bournemouth) comes to nothing.

45+5' David Brooks (Bournemouth) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bournemouth.
45+2' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
43' A cross from a corner kick by Bournemouth is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
39' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes. Ball possession – 60:40.
39' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Thomas Bramall no option but to blow his whistle.
38' Matt Doherty (Wolves) serves up a nice cross, but Djordje Petrovic punches the ball away.
36' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
35' Ki-Jana Hoever is being substituted because of an injury. Vitor Pereira sends Jackson Tchatchoua (Wolves) on the pitch.
33' Joao Gomes (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Thomas Bramall blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) is able to continue to play.
28' The game is interrupted now, Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Thomas Bramall has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
26' Bournemouth can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
25' A corner kick by Bournemouth is thwarted by the well prepared Jose Sa (Wolves).
25' Ki-Jana Hoever (Wolves) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
23' Ki-Jana Hoever (Wolves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
22' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
20' Thomas Bramall blows for a foul after Joao Gomes (Wolves) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
18' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Wolves.

18' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) escapes his marker to meet a cross and heads to the middle of the goal, but the keeper pulls off an excellent reflex save to deny him. The ball is out of play and Wolves manage to earn a corner.
17' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bournemouth was in an offside position.
15' David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' Bournemouth are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
11' Rough tackle by David Brooks (Bournemouth). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bournemouth comes to nothing.
9' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Toti (Wolves) was quite harsh and Thomas Bramall didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
8' Wolves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Antoine Semenyo plays it to Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Jose Sa. 1:0.

3' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) blew a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross deep inside the box, but his shot flew just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.

2' David Brooks (Bournemouth) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
2' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Bournemouth will kick-off.
Thomas Bramall is the one to supervise the game today.
